regime.summary: Policy rate held at 10.5% with the 6M bill at 10.44%, so the curve prices no move. CPI is falling. The KMI fell 8.0% in a month after a strong 12 months, so this is a pullback inside an uptrend, not a confirmed break. Foreigners are selling. Mixed, so neutral with a modest core and cash.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 10.5%; last MPC decision 2026-01-26: hold (+0bp)
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate -0.06pp (market near policy rate); CPI falling over 3 months (-0.5pp)
Lesson: hold the core; keep cash ready for a weekend gap.

core.thesis: Power names led the last 6 months and are the cheapest on the screen: P/E 3.875 with a 10.9% dividend yield and EPS growth of 159% year on year. Fell with the market, still 9.9% below its 252-day high. Core hold, not a trade.
Fertilizer sector led the last 6 months (+24%). FFC trades at P/E 5.523 with an 11.2% yield. Latest EPS growth is slightly negative (-2.7%), so the weight is kept small.
